cases.name: maillist-tests-parse-index-reads-thread-rows
cases.purpose: A public-inbox index becomes thread rows with date, size and nesting.

cases.name: maillist-tests-parse-thread-keeps-messages-and-senders
cases.purpose: A thread document yields its subject, senders and reply nesting.

cases.name: maillist-tests-classify-lines-names-quotes-and-patches
cases.purpose: Body classification marks quotes, diff hunks and prose with stable ids.

cases.name: maillist-tests-parse-author-reads-the-from-header
cases.purpose: A raw message's From header becomes the list's sender, decoded and unfolded.

cases.name: maillist-tests-day-labels-follow-the-calendar
cases.purpose: Timestamps read as a clock today and as yesterday before that.

cases.name: maillist-tests-session-syncs-a-local-archive
cases.purpose: A session lists a local archive's threads and opens one with its messages.

cases.name: maillist-tests-read-and-star-survive-a-restart
cases.purpose: An opened thread stays read and a starred thread stays starred after a restart.

cases.name: maillist-tests-unanswered-index-keeps-the-list
cases.purpose: An archive answer without thread rows fails the sync and keeps the stored list.

cases.name: maillist-tests-lists-do-not-share-stored-threads
cases.purpose: Threads are stored per archive, so another list does not show them.

cases.name: maillist-tests-compile-query-maps-fields-and-marks
cases.purpose: Reader search syntax becomes an archive query plus local mark filters.

cases.name: maillist-tests-local-mark-filters-narrow-the-list
cases.purpose: is:unread and is:starred filter the visible rows without a request.

cases.name: maillist-tests-failed-search-keeps-the-open-thread
cases.purpose: A search the archive cannot answer reports and leaves the reader alone.

cases.name: maillist-tests-reply-targets-the-list-or-the-author
cases.purpose: A reply addresses the list; a private reply addresses the last sender.

cases.name: maillist-tests-scope-shows-starred-and-unread-rows
cases.purpose: The starred and unread scopes filter the rows the list shows.

cases.name: maillist-tests-long-thread-shows-newest-messages-first
cases.purpose: A thread starts with a window of new messages and grows on demand.

cases.name: maillist-tests-refresh-keeps-threads-the-index-dropped
cases.purpose: A refresh merges the index page into the stored list, keeping older threads and their marks.

cases.name: maillist-tests-read-mark-waits-for-the-body
cases.purpose: A thread whose body never arrives stays unread after it was selected.

cases.name: maillist-tests-search-rows-stay-out-of-the-cache
cases.purpose: Opening a search result leaves the archive cache's stored facts unchanged.

cases.name: maillist-tests-incompatible-cache-is-rebuilt
cases.purpose: An unreadable cache file is moved aside and rebuilt, so persistence keeps working.

cases.name: maillist-tests-open-mounts-and-close-releases
cases.purpose: Opening mounts a live client with its chrome and closing kills the buffer.
